DGX Spark GRPO Training Pipeline — Built + Datasets Downloading

## What Changed This Session
Danny clarified the GOAL: build a general logician/coder expert on par with frontier models, not just medical. Medical is just one application of strong general reasoning.

## Key Insight
SFT teaches a model to SOUND smart. GRPO with execution verification teaches it to BE smart.
The reward signal must be objective and binary: code compiles, tests pass, proofs typecheck, math equals the right number.

## 4-Layer Training Stack
1. SFT Foundation (DONE — 7.93M examples, 8 scripts ready)
2. GRPO with Execution Verification (NEW — the force multiplier)
3. Agentic Coding Traces (NEW — write-run-fix debugging loops)
4. Self-play (FUTURE — infinite training loop)
